signal-faraday.title: Stanford Research Systems (2026). RGA100, RGA200, and RGA300 Operating Manual and Programming Reference, revision 1.9: Ion Detector, sections 3-13–3-14.
signal-faraday.note: Official manual, revision September 2026, PDF pages 57–58 inspected. Supports direct charge collection versus multiplied electron current. No pressure limits, universal mass-independent response, servicing advice, or product ranking is transferred.

signal-charge.title: BIPM. The International System of Units (SI): Defining constants.
signal-charge.note: Official fixed elementary-charge value e = 1.602176634 × 10⁻¹⁹ C. The charge/current calculation is original and assumes complete collection with no secondary-electron loss or interfering current.

signal-multiplier.title: IUPAC Gold Book. Secondary electron multiplier, entry S05517.
signal-multiplier.note: Official indexed/plain definition from IUPAC recommendations. Supports repeated secondary emission at successive electrodes or locations. The five-stage gain example is constructed; no fixed gain or unit detection efficiency is claimed.

signal-detector-families.title: Hamamatsu Photonics. Mass spectrometry: detector technologies.
signal-detector-families.note: Official manufacturer description of electron multipliers, microchannel plates and conversion arrangements. Used only for detector mechanisms and architectural variety, not comparative performance or purchasing guidance.

signal-dual-mode.title: Hamamatsu Photonics. Electron multiplier R13733: dual-mode analog/counting design.
signal-dual-mode.note: Official product documentation confirms that electron multiplication does not prescribe one readout mode. Model-specific gain, voltage, timing and current specifications are deliberately not generalized.

signal-tof-readout.title: Fjeldsted, J. (2003). Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometry. Agilent Technologies technical overview 5989-0373EN.
signal-tof-readout.note: Official technical overview, PDF pages 7–11, describes TDC/ADC readout, discrimination, recovery/dead-time losses and finite measurement range. Historical product comparisons, quantitative performance and one-ion-per-transient assumptions are not generalized. The clipping fixture is original, not an instrument model.

signal-image-detection.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific. Orbitrap Astral Operating Manual: Ion detection.
signal-image-detection.note: Official functional-description page inspected. Supports differential split-electrode image-current detection, coherent axial motion, digitization and Fourier processing. This concerns the Orbitrap analyzer only; it does not describe the separate Astral analyzer detector or assert performance specifications.

signal-poisson.title: NIST/SEMATECH. e-Handbook of Statistical Methods: Poisson Distribution, section 1.3.6.6.19.
signal-poisson.note: Official distribution definition, mean, standard deviation and coefficient of variation. The 25/100-count examples are ideal repeated-measurement calculations, not claims that arbitrary mass-spectral intensities follow Poisson statistics.

signal-hires-picker.title: OpenMS. PeakPickerHiRes class documentation.
signal-hires-picker.note: Official developer documentation inspected 2026-10-07; generated page dated 2026-09-30. Describes cubic-spline peak reconstruction, reporting its maximum, optional width information and applicable data assumptions. No parameter defaults or universal algorithm recommendation is prescribed.

signal-smoothing.title: OpenMS. Smoothing Raw Data: TOPPView user tutorial.
signal-smoothing.note: Official indexed tutorial verified; direct open returned an extraction error. Supports explicit Gaussian-width and Savitzky–Golay frame/order choices. The moving-average example is independently constructed, not an OpenMS output or a claim about these filters.

signal-snr-definition.title: IUPAC Gold Book. Signal-to-noise ratio, entry 08282.
signal-snr-definition.note: Official indexed definition and notes inspected; direct opening returned 403. Source: Glossary of methods and terms used in analytical spectroscopy (IUPAC Recommendations 2019), published 2021. Supports distinguishing power and amplitude conventions. Height/RMS and peak-to-peak examples are explicitly stated analytical conventions, not restatements of a universal IUPAC formula.

signal-icis-noise.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific. FreeStyle User Guide 1.8 SP3 QF1: ICIS Signal-to-noise estimation.
signal-icis-noise.note: Official full page inspected. Documents neighboring-point and iterative chromatogram-noise estimates. Used to demonstrate algorithm dependence; its formulas, thresholds and defaults are not generalized to mass spectra or validated analytical limits.

signal-filter-order.title: ProteoWizard. Technical Documentation: Filters.
signal-filter-order.note: Official direct filter documentation inspected. Supports sequential operations and distinction between vendor-specific and alternative peak picking. The existing msconvert-filters reference points to a different overview page; this additive reference identifies the directly inspected filter-order source. No command recipe or unstable default is prescribed.
